anchor.statement: Proposition B.5. The analytic axis profile can be continued to X i with positive E, remaining unchanged for X ≤ X 0 . Its stress has the factorization T 0 = e a B 0 , where the scalar factor e a vanishes to infinite order at X 0 and the smooth vector coefficient B 0 is nonzero there. The admissible stress cone holds on a first collar, and the strict relaxed cone condition holds on the rest of (X 0 , X i ]. At X i , a = .8, D X U = 0, and p 1 > 2.

correspondence.note: Split into the continuation to X = 110 (admissible cone on a first collar, strict relaxed cone from the start radius to 110, p1 > 2 on the final hold), the factorization T0 = e_a·D with D smooth and its first component bounded below at the edge, a = 4/5 with zero axial shear on the final hold, and the fields being unchanged and positive up to X0.

conclusion.text:
have N := NavierStokes.ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family;
have L := NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ;
have U := NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.refAxial N δ;
have I := NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0;
∃ (D : NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.ScaledPoint → ℝ × ℝ) (ε : ℝ),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) D (NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.scaledDomain NavierStokes.ReferencePath.parameterInterval) ∧
    0 < ε ∧
      (∀ (κ T η : ℝ),
          η ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1 →
            ε ≤ (D ((κ, T), 0, η)).1 ∧
              ε ≤
                (D ((κ, T), 0, η)).1 +
                    NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (0, η) /
                        NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceP1 L (0, η) *
                      (D ((κ, T), 0, η)).2 -
                  2 * NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceAngular L (0, η)) ∧
        ∀ (T : ℝ),
          0 < T →
            ∀ (κ u η : ℝ),
              T * u ∈ Set.Icc 0 δ →
                η ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1 →
                  NavierStokes.ActivationCone.activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (T * u, η) =
                    (NavierStokes.StressActivation.activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), u, η)).1,
                      NavierStokes.StressActivation.activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), u, η)).2)

∀ {h j σ Λ C : ℝ} {P0 : ℝ → ℝ} {d : NavierStokes.NaturalAxisCoefficients.AnalyticInputs h j σ P0} (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
  (F : NavierStokes.NaturalEntrance.EntranceProfile d Λ C) (hP0 : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) P0),
  NavierStokes.NaturalAxisData.SmallParameters h j →
    ∀ {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδlim : 2 * δ < NavierStokes.ReferencePath.rampLimit),
      have N := NavierStokes.ReferencePath.Input.ofNatural hΛ F.profile.family;
      have L := NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.refLog N δ;
      have U := NavierStokes.StressActivation.FromReference.refAxial N δ;
      have I := NavierStokes.ActivationStocks.FromReference.initial N hδ hδlim P0 hP0;
      ∃ (D : NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.ScaledPoint → ℝ × ℝ) (ε : ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) D (NavierStokes.ActivationBounds.scaledDomain NavierStokes.ReferencePath.parameterInterval) ∧
          0 < ε ∧
            (∀ (κ T η : ℝ),
                η ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1 →
                  ε ≤ (D ((κ, T), 0, η)).1 ∧
                    ε ≤
                      (D ((κ, T), 0, η)).1 +
                          NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceP2 N.endpoint L U (0, η) /
                              NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceP1 L (0, η) *
                            (D ((κ, T), 0, η)).2 -
                        2 * NavierStokes.StressActivation.referenceAngular L (0, η)) ∧
              ∀ (T : ℝ),
                0 < T →
                  ∀ (κ u η : ℝ),
                    T * u ∈ Set.Icc 0 δ →
                      η ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1 →
                        NavierStokes.ActivationCone.activatedStress h N.endpoint I L U T κ (T * u, η) =
                          (NavierStokes.StressActivation.activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), u, η)).1,
                            NavierStokes.StressActivation.activation 1 κ u * (D ((κ, T), u, η)).2)
